result.title: Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation for Synthetic Segmentation Data
result.summary: Synthetic images sharing a segmentation label can differ in their training value. We propose Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation (TCDA) to select useful candidates and locally edit some remaining images. We ask whether image details provide class-specific cues in the regions marked by the label. We train a small task reference on frozen image features from real training images. We compare its class responses before and after blurring each candidate, and score how well these response changes align with the labeled regions. This detail allocation score ranks candidates from the same source. Comparing their response--label alignment with that of the real source image also guides repair decisions and, in multiclass tasks, the choice of regions to edit. Selected candidates and accepted repairs are used for training with the original labels and the unchanged downstream segmenter. Experiments on camouflaged object detection, degraded salient object detection, and adverse-condition semantic segmentation show that our selection outperforms equally sized random and label-agreement subsets. Combining selection and repair improves over real-only training by up to 0.019 in $S_α$ on COD10K and 2.86 mIoU points on ACDC.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Task-Conditioned Detail Allocation（TCDA）：在冻结图像特征上训练小型任务参考模型，比较每张候选图被模糊前后类别响应的变化与标注区域是否对齐，据此为合成分割数据打分、筛选并局部修复。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用冻结特征探针加模糊扰动来判断「局部细节是否携带任务相关线索」的打分思路，可能为 LVR 中哪些视觉细节值得写入 latent 状态、如何筛选视觉证据提供可核查的方法线索，但任务本身是分割数据筛选，需较多迁移。
